title: Top Financial Planning Software With Cash Flow, Balance Sheet and Three-Statement Features for CFOs in 2026
summary: Compare eight platforms for cash flow, balance sheet and three-statement planning: Abacum, Anaplan, Cube, Datarails, Planful, Prophix, Vena and Workday.
body_markdown:
**Updated October 2026**


The best provider of cash flow, balance sheet and three-statement planning for a CFO is the one that lets you answer your hardest questions from one connected model: can we fund the plan, are we inside our covenants, and what do we tell the board? Eight platforms stand out: Abacum, Anaplan, Cube, Datarails, Planful, Prophix, Vena and Workday Adaptive Planning. They differ on three lines: whether cash comes from a dedicated 13-week module or from the three-statement model, whether the work stays in Excel or moves to a modeling layer, and how far planning reaches beyond finance. This guide organizes the choice around the decisions a CFO has to make, then compares the platforms side by side.


We build Abacum, so we list it first and the rest alphabetically. Abacum is the AI-native business planning platform for scaling enterprises. It brings all your data, business logic and business context into one governed place.


## Key takeaways


-


Choose by decision, not by feature count. Name the five or six decisions your team makes every quarter, then test each platform against them.


-


A cash forecast that sits apart from the P&L and balance sheet goes stale the moment an assumption changes. Three-statement planning keeps all three in step.


-


Run two horizons from one model: a 13-week view for liquidity and a 12 to 36 month view for the plan, both fed by the same actuals.


-


Interest, revolver draws and covenant ratios create circular logic. Check how each engine handles it.


-


Ask who runs the rollout, how long the first plan takes to go live, and which security certifications are current.

## What to look for when choosing the software


1.


**Statement integration.** The P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statement are built from live ERP actuals, update together and trace back to the transaction.


2.


**Horizon coverage.** One model supports the 13-week view and the annual plan on the same actuals and drivers.


3.


**Multi-entity roll-ups.** Look at roll-ups with FX translation, entity structure, and whether more than one ERP can feed the same model.


4.


**Calculation engine.** Test whether interest and revolver draws calculate natively or need an iterative-calculation workaround.


5.


**Scenario reach.** A scenario flows through all three statements without manual links.


6.


**Spreadsheet fit.** Decide whether you want to keep working in Excel or move to a dedicated modeling layer.


7.


**Time to value and security.** Ask who runs the rollout and which certifications are current.


## The eight platforms


### Abacum: three statements, cash and scenarios in one connected model


Abacum builds the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statement from live ERP actuals and keeps revenue, hiring and cash scenarios in the same connected model. Its calculation engine natively supports circular references, so interest, debt balances and revolver draws run without iterative-calculation workarounds. Multi-entity roll-ups use a dimension-based model, with currency translated at the FX rates you set. Abacum connects to 700+ integrations, including NetSuite, SAP S/4HANA, SAP Business ByDesign, Sage Intacct, Xero and QuickBooks. Implementation is finance-owned and runs six to nine weeks, depending on data complexity, entity count and workflows, guided by in-house FP&A experts. Abacum is rated 4.7 out of 5 on G2 (October 2026), and is SOC 2 Type II certified, ISO 27001 certified and GDPR compliant.


**Best for:** finance teams running multi-entity, multi-location planning that want statements, cash and scenarios in one connected model.


### Anaplan: connected planning across functions


Anaplan is a connected-planning platform for teams that plan across finance, sales, supply chain and HR. Its integrated financial statements link the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, and it adds AI-assisted scenario modeling ([anaplan.com](https://www.anaplan.com/) ).


**Best for:** teams connecting planning across finance, sales, supply chain and HR.


### Cube: scenario modeling with direct and indirect cash flow methods


Cube keeps live actuals, assumptions and scenarios maintained together, and supports direct and indirect cash flow methods alongside scenario modeling. It works with Excel and Google Sheets ([cubesoftware.com](https://www.cubesoftware.com/) ).


**Best for:** teams that want direct and indirect cash flow methods alongside scenario modeling.


### Datarails: Excel-native with live bank connections


Datarails is an Excel-native financial operating system that keeps full Excel functionality. It describes real-time bank connections that give live bank-to-dashboard cash visibility, and 600+ integrations ([datarails.com](https://www.datarails.com/) ).


**Best for:** teams that want live bank-to-dashboard cash visibility with Excel.


### Planful: structured 13-week cash forecasting


Planful unifies close, planning and reporting, and includes a 13-week cash flow module with AP, AR and payroll inputs ([planful.com](https://www.planful.com/) ). Comparing Abacum and Planful? See[Abacum vs Planful](https://www.abacum.ai/compare/vs-planful) .


**Best for:** finance teams that need a structured 13-week treasury forecast.


### Prophix: cross-entity cash visibility


Prophix offers 13-week cash forecasting with cross-entity visibility and collections tracking ([prophix.com](https://www.prophix.com/) ).


**Best for:** organizations that need one view of cash across several entities.


### Vena: driver-based cash modeling in an Excel-based process


Vena delivers Excel-native, Microsoft-native planning with workflow that runs through Microsoft 365, Teams and Power BI. It supports direct and indirect cash flow methods, with weekly, monthly or daily planning intervals.


**Best for:** teams that want driver-based cash modeling inside an Excel-based process.


### Workday Adaptive Planning: fast recalculation inside the Workday ecosystem


Workday Adaptive Planning delivers finance-led planning tied into the Workday HR and finance ecosystem. Its in-memory calculation refreshes plans quickly, and it works with any ERP or GL data source ([workday.com](https://www.workday.com/en-us/products/adaptive-planning/overview.html) ). Comparing Abacum and Adaptive? See[Abacum vs Adaptive](https://www.abacum.ai/compare/vs-adaptive) .


**Best for:** organizations already invested in the Workday ecosystem.

## How Abacum helps a CFO decide faster


Our core view is that planning should shorten the distance between a question and a decision. Abacum plans, forecasts and reports at weekly granularity, so you can steer the business every week instead of reporting on it every quarter, and answer the board's question the same day it is asked.


-


**One plan the whole business runs on.** Finance, reporting and budgeting share a single source of truth, so every team works from the same numbers and every version reconciles.


-


**Scenarios that reach cash.** Base, bull and bear cases are built off the same base version. Scenario Studio works backward from a target: you set the outcome and limits on any input, and goal seek finds the inputs that get there, with every assumption visible and every adjustment auditable.


-


**AI you can defend in the boardroom.** AI-generated variance commentary flows into your narrative reporting and board pack. Every output links back to its source data and assumptions. AI does the production work, and finance keeps the judgment. More than 85% of our customers use AI in Abacum every month (Abacum customer usage, October 2026).


-


**Models that evolve when you ask.** AI Modeler lets you describe a model in plain language and get a working model in minutes. The agent proposes, the planning engine calculates, and finance approves every change to reported figures.


-


**Spreadsheet flexibility without spreadsheet limits.** The Excel connector lets you import a budget or forecast as a version, or export your work to Excel and Google Sheets. See the[Excel connector](https://www.abacum.ai/excel-connector) .
